feature: Revival satu notice dari halaman detail notice (operasi Revival di staff portal)
note: Selain jalur pencarian notice -> halaman Revival, halaman detail notice punya operasi REVIVAL untuk satu notice: memakai suspensionType terakhir notice dan POST staff-revive-suspension yang sama dengan reason/remark dari form revival_. Story 19.6-19.10 hanya menyebut pilih dari hasil search/upload, jadi jalur detail notice belum tentu tercakup story mana pun di chunk ini; perlu dicek apakah ada story lain yang menaunginya.
note_en: Besides the notice search -> Revival page path, the notice detail page has a REVIVAL operation for a single notice: it uses the notice's last suspensionType and POSTs the same staff-revive-suspension with the reason/remark from the revival_ form. Stories 19.6-19.10 only mention picking from search/upload results, so the notice-detail path is not necessarily covered by any story in this chunk; check whether another story owns it.
